_comment: Sera Unified Dialect Recognition (SUDR) — canonical event vocabulary. This is the ONLY file that should change when adapting SUDR to a new portal or a new kind of event. Every protocol.js and every downstream consumer (timeline_decoder.py, main.py) reads from this file — neither side should hardcode a copy of this table.

LOGIN_SUCCESS.label: Logged In
LOGIN_SUCCESS.description: User successfully authenticated on the portal.

PORTAL_VIEW.label: Viewing Portal
PORTAL_VIEW.description: Landing page or dashboard viewed, no specific form/action yet.

FORM_VIEW.label: Viewing Form
FORM_VIEW.description: User is looking at or filling a specific form/period selection screen.

FILING_SUBMITTED.label: Filing Submitted
FILING_SUBMITTED.description: Filing/statement submitted but not yet verified or processed by the portal.

FILING_VERIFIED.label: Filing Verified
FILING_VERIFIED.description: Filing confirmed / processed / verified by the portal — final success state.

RETURNS_LIST_VIEW.label: Viewing Return History
RETURNS_LIST_VIEW.description: User is browsing a list/history of past filings or statements.

LOGOUT.label: Logged Out
LOGOUT.description: Session ended, normally or via timeout.

ERROR.label: Error / Rejected
ERROR.description: Capture attempted but the portal reported a failure/default/rejection state, or the page state was unrecognized.

_change_log.note: Initial SUDR vocabulary, derived from live ITR + GST crosshair statuses and mapped onto TRACES.
